Pooja Deshmukh | Nagpur, Maharashtra | pooja.deshmukh.qa@example.com

EDUCATION
BCA, Vidarbha College of Computer Applications, Nagpur (2023 - 2026) | CGPA 8.2/10

INTERNSHIP
QA Intern, Orange City Softlabs, Nagpur (Jan 2026 - Mar 2026, 10 weeks)
- Wrote and executed 120 test cases for the checkout and payment screens of a food ordering web app.
- Logged 35 defects in Jira with steps to reproduce, screenshots and severity.
- Tested order and login REST endpoints in Postman and checked status codes and response fields.
- Attended daily stand-ups and sprint reviews in two-week sprints with the development team.

PROJECTS
- Test suite for college library portal (academic, Software Testing course): Wrote boundary value and equivalence class test cases for the issue and return forms as part of the Software Testing course.
- Bug bash: Tested a classmate's Android expense app and reported 12 usability bugs in a shared sheet.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (2025)
- Coursework: Software Engineering, Software Testing, DBMS, Web Technologies

SKILLS
Manual testing, Test case design, Test planning, Jira, Postman, SQL (basic SELECT queries), MS Excel

ACTIVITIES
- Event coordinator, BCA department tech fest
- Kho-kho, inter-college team
